checkpoint_review: The Router was generally reasonable but slightly too lenient on the 'Item names... listed systematically' checkpoint. While the layout mimics a list, the complete lack of legible characters means the 'systematic listing' is purely structural hallucination, not functional. I agree with marking text-heavy checkpoints as untestable due to blur/gibberish, but the presence of gibberish itself is a failure of the 'menu' class definition which requires readable text.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified 'text_gibberish' (Severity 4.0) and 'blur' (Severity 3.0). However, the Router underestimated the severity of the 'structural_collapse' in the hand/thumb area. The topology_boundary_auditor gave a high confidence score (0.99), but this only confirms the mask exists, not that the anatomy is correct. Visually, the thumb lacks nail definition and blends into the paper, a classic AI fusion artifact. The perceptual_quality_auditor reported 'slight' blur (0.2), which contradicts the visual evidence of significant global softness and lack of micro-texture on the paper. I will upgrade the global blur severity to moderate-severe (3.5) as it obscures all fine details expected in a close-up.
alignment_reasoning: The fine_grained_classifier correctly identifies the object as a 'menu' (Top-1), confirming basic semantic alignment. However, the image fails the core functional requirement of a menu: legible text. The image_text_auditor found zero readable blocks. While the layout (columns, prices) mimics a menu, the content is nonsensical blobs. This reduces alignment significantly below a perfect score, as a menu without readable text is functionally broken, even if visually recognizable as one.
artifact_reasoning: Major artifacts detected: 1) Text Gibberish (Severity 4.0): Complete failure to render characters, confirmed by empty OCR output. 2) Global Blur/Smearing (Severity 3.5): Exceeds natural motion blur; lacks paper texture grain. 3) Hand/Paper Fusion (Severity 3.0): Thumb anatomy is vague and merges with the menu edge. These compound to create a low-quality, clearly AI-generated image with significant structural and textual defects.
